findings.description: The scoped step still cannot demonstrate autonomous Jev compaction in either lane. Exact merged adapter 8392f4a installed in the private OMP lab and the approved saved-settings copy was regular mode 0600, but native omp login openai-codex reached an OpenAI account-login page requiring authentication unavailable to this agent. Normal Claude authentication is available; both HOME-only and CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR isolated auth checks returned loggedIn=false, and the real Claude TUI required a new login. No qualifying turn, actual Jev judgment, native automatic compaction, or before/after context was obtained. Main must arrange lab-owned OMP OAuth completion and supply a supported isolated Claude route, or explicitly authorize lab-owned Claude login and saving the approved adviser key into lab-only Claude plugin settings. No operator agent.db attachment/copy, other credential copies, or shared preferences changes were used. Both labs and the approved settings copy were removed.

The broader host-recovery pause remains active. Main031 lifted it only for these two native turns; Main must explicitly authorize resumption before other scenarios or pipeline phases. This result does not approve full dual-lane acceptance or waive remaining proof.
